description: A published astrophotography collection: an ordered set of gallery.astra.image records with a title, optional description and date range, and a visibility rule. Derived from Astra's ShareManifest (viewer/src/types.ts).

main.description: One published collection. The record key is the collection's publish slug (e.g. `orion-session`), so existing astra.gallery URLs map one-to-one onto at:// URIs; hence `any` rather than `tid`.

template.description: Viewer layout hint, e.g. `messier`. From ShareManifest.template / collections.template. Viewers that do not recognise the value fall back to the default layout.

createdAt.description: When the collection was created (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 with time zone). From collections.created_at.

updatedAt.description: When the collection or its membership last changed. From ShareManifest.updatedAt.

dateRangeStart.description: Start of the imaging date range the collection covers, if the author set one. From ShareManifest.dateRangeStart (collections.metadata.dateFilter.start), widened to a full datetime.

dateRangeEnd.description: End of the imaging date range, if set. From ShareManifest.dateRangeEnd (collections.metadata.dateFilter.end).

images.description: Ordered member images, each a strong reference to a gallery.astra.image record. From ShareManifest.images; the order is the gallery's display order.

visibility.description: Who may see the collection. `public`: listed on the author's profile; `unlisted`: reachable by URL only. Values of the form `circle:<name>` restrict the collection to a named kith circle of the author, so this is an open string with known values rather than a closed enum. From published_collections.visibility.

coverImage.description: The image to use as the collection's card/cover. Usually one of `images`; viewers fall back to images[0] when absent.

imageRef.description: A strong (URI + CID) reference to a gallery.astra.image record, in the same shape as com.atproto.repo.strongRef.

uri.description: at://<did>/gallery.astra.image/<tid> of the referenced image record.

cid.description: CID of the referenced image record at the time the collection was written.
